firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
As stated here:
https://www.kaggle.com/discussions/general/696346

Iam happy to announce iam using a brand new library i build the last month which relies on conditional tree split criteria instead of the common split criterias we are familiar with in xgboost or catboost.
You can take a look at my current notebook for this challenge
https://www.kaggle.com/code/maiernator/ps-s6e5-ctboost-gpu-starter
Be aware its takes a long time to run, you can lower the folds to 3 and it talks less than 2 hours.
Ctboost also for CPU inference only, contributions for further improvements, issues etc are welcome at.
https://github.com/captnmarkus/ctboost
https://pypi.org/project/ctboost/

Have fun playing around with it in this comp. 
Also keep in mind it will perform different on real datasets, as the current data diviates quite a bit from realistic data, reminds me of the car engine data we had last year with the same issues
